quienes_somos.title: About Us
quienes_somos.desc: History, mission, and vision of GT Peru Travel.
quienes_somos.keywords: about us, gt peru travel, travel agency
quienes_somos.intro:
We are GT Peru Travel, and we believe every journey should be a transformative experience. From hikes through the most breathtaking landscapes to deep cultural immersions, every adventure with us is unforgettable.

Mission
To inspire travelers to discover the cultural, historical, and natural richness of Peru by offering personalized tours and high-quality services, always with a sustainable and environmentally responsible approach.

Vision
To be the leading tourism company in Cusco, recognized for excellence in service, innovation in travel experiences, and commitment to local development.
quienes_somos.content: Here goes the main About Us content.

terminos_y_condiciones.title: Terms and Conditions
terminos_y_condiciones.desc: General conditions for use and bookings.
terminos_y_condiciones.intro: Please read these Terms and Conditions carefully before using our services or making a reservation.
terminos_y_condiciones.content:
1. Acceptance of Terms
By accessing our website or booking a service with GT Peru Travel, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part, we recommend not using our services.


2. Bookings and Payments
A reservation is considered confirmed only after the corresponding payment has been processed and a confirmation email has been issued. Any changes or cancellations are subject to our specific policies according to the type of service booked.


3. Permitted Use of the Website
All content on this site (texts, images, videos, and graphics) is the property of GT Peru Travel. Total or partial reproduction without written authorization is strictly prohibited. You also agree not to use the site for illegal, unauthorized, or disruptive activities.


4. Liability
We are not responsible for delays, rescheduling, or inconveniences caused by external factors beyond our control, such as weather conditions, roadblocks, strikes, or unforeseen situations. We recommend arriving early to all scheduled activities.


5. Data Protection
Your personal information is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. We ensure the confidentiality and security of your data, which will be used only for operational and administrative purposes.


6. Modifications to the Terms
GT Peru Travel reserves the right to update or modify these Terms and Conditions as needed. Any changes will be published on this page and will take effect immediately.


By using our services, you fully accept these Terms and Conditions.

politica_de_privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
politica_de_privacidad.desc: How we protect, manage, and use your personal data.
politica_de_privacidad.keywords: privacy policy, personal data, security, data protection, cookies
politica_de_privacidad.intro: Your privacy is essential to us. Please review our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your information.
politica_de_privacidad.content:
1. Information We Collect
We collect only the data necessary to provide you with a safe and efficient service.
Personal data: Name, email, phone number, and other information relevant for managing bookings and inquiries.
Browsing information: Use of cookies and technical device data to improve your experience.
Payment data: Information used exclusively to process transactions securely through authorized platforms.


2. How We Use Your Information
Booking management: Confirming, organizing, and administering requested services.
Experience improvements: Analyzing preferences to optimize our services and site functionality.
Communications: Sending relevant information, promotions, and important updates, always with your voluntary consent.


3. Data Protection
We apply advanced security measures such as SSL encryption, access controls, and digital protection practices to prevent unauthorized access. Your data will not be shared with third parties unless it is necessary to complete your booking.


4. Use of Cookies
We use cookies to improve navigation, analyze user behavior, and present relevant content. You can disable cookies at any time through your browser settings.


5. Your Rights
You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. You can also opt out of promotional communications through the unsubscribe link included in each message.


6. Policy Updates
GT Peru Travel reserves the right to modify this Privacy Policy when necessary. Changes will be posted on this page and will take effect immediately.


By using our services, you accept the terms of this Privacy Policy.

proteccion_de_datos.intro: We comply with the Peruvian Personal Data Protection Law and ensure that your information is handled with confidentiality and responsibility.

autorizaciones.title: Authorizations
autorizaciones.desc: Permissions you grant GT Peru Travel when making a reservation.
autorizaciones.keywords: authorizations, permissions, service coordination, tour management
autorizaciones.intro: When booking with us, you grant certain authorizations required for the proper management and operation of your service.
autorizaciones.content:
1. Service Coordination on Your Behalf
You authorize GT Peru Travel to manage and coordinate essential services such as official guides, tourist transportation, entrance tickets, train tickets, and other operational requirements related to your booking.


2. Use of Data for Operational Management
You allow your personal information (name, document ID, contact details) to be used exclusively to process permits, tickets, internal bookings, and any other necessary procedures for the proper execution of the tour.


3. Communication with Providers
You grant us authorization to contact external providers—such as operators, hotels, or transportation companies—on your behalf to confirm availability, coordinate schedules, and ensure a complete and organized experience.


These authorizations are necessary to guarantee proper service operation.

metodos_de_pago.title: Payment Methods
metodos_de_pago.desc: Accepted payment methods at GT Peru Travel.
metodos_de_pago.keywords: payments, cards, transfers, deposits, advance payments
metodos_de_pago.intro: We offer several secure and certified payment methods to process your reservations.
metodos_de_pago.content:
1. Cards and Digital Payments
We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, and compatible brands), as well as authorized electronic payment platforms. All processes are handled through secure gateways.


2. Bank Transfers and Deposits
You can make payments via bank transfer or direct deposit into our official accounts. Once the payment is made, you must send the receipt to confirm your reservation.


3. Advance Payments and Provider Policies
Certain services, such as train tickets or official entrance tickets, require non-refundable advance payments set by the providers. These payments are necessary to secure availability and complete your booking.

politica_de_cancelacion.title: Cancellation Policy
politica_de_cancelacion.intro: Our cancellation policy aims to provide clarity and transparency when modifying or canceling a service.
politica_de_cancelacion.content:
1. Non-Refundable Services
Certain services such as Machu Picchu entrance tickets, train tickets, and special permits cannot be canceled or refunded due to provider regulations.


2. Cancellations in Advance
Standard tours and regular services may be canceled or rescheduled depending on the required notice period specified in our policies. Administrative fees may apply.


3. No Show
If the traveler does not show up on the day of the service without prior notice, the amount paid is non-refundable due to operational costs and blocked reservations.

facturacion.title: Invoices and Billing
facturacion.content:
1. Types of Receipts: We issue electronic receipts or invoices according to Peruvian regulations.

2. Data Submission: Billing information must be provided before making the payment. Without complete data, an invoice cannot be issued.

3. Final Document: Once issued, the receipt or invoice cannot be modified, canceled, or reissued.

soporte_cliente.title: Customer Support
soporte_cliente.desc: Customer service at GT Peru Travel.
soporte_cliente.content:

compromiso_calidad.title: Quality Commitment
compromiso_calidad.content:

3. Continuous Improvement: We monitor each service and collect feedback to optimize routes, service quality, and overall experience.

preguntas_frecuentes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
preguntas_frecuentes.desc: Common questions about our tours, reservations, and services.
preguntas_frecuentes.intro: We answer the most common questions from our travelers to help you plan your experience in Peru.
preguntas_frecuentes.content: Here you will find clear and updated answers regarding reservations, payments, policies, logistics, and travel recommendations.

faq.pregunta: How can I book a tour?
faq.respuesta: You can book directly through our website using secure payment, or contact us via WhatsApp for personalized assistance.
No. Entry tickets to Machu Picchu and train tickets are non-refundable according to official provider policies.

faq.pregunta: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.respuesta: We accept credit/debit cards, bank transfers, deposits, and authorized payment platforms. Some services require non-refundable advance payments.

faq.pregunta: What should I bring for tours in Cusco?
faq.respuesta: We recommend warm clothing, water, sunscreen, snacks, a rain poncho, and comfortable shoes. For tours above 4,000 m, stay hydrated and avoid heavy meals.

faq.pregunta: Is it safe to travel in Peru?
faq.respuesta: Yes. Tourist routes are safe and monitored. We coordinate all services to ensure a reliable and organized experience.

faq.pregunta: Can I modify or reschedule my reservation?
faq.respuesta: Yes, most tours allow rescheduling with prior notice. However, non-refundable services such as Machu Picchu tickets and trains cannot be modified once issued.
